_meta.note: Three gate-quality strengthenings from the self-analysis: (1) outcome-asserting coverage — run-tests.sh emits a machine-checkable GROUPS-PASSED line so a coverage gate asserts a group PASSED, not that a header exists (a bare-header grep passes on a red suite through a pipe); (2) replace source-string grep gates with behavioral checks and rewrite our planning coverage gates to the marker; (3) clean the default template's gate_offphase so the exemplar users copy is warning-free. This plan's own gates model the new pattern: outcome-asserting (green + marker) and behavioral (audit warns==0), never a bare-header grep.

tasks.title: Author T52 (marker)
tasks.description: Add T52 to tests/run-tests.sh asserting the suite prints a GROUPS-PASSED line that lists a fully-passing group (outcome), so coverage gates can assert a group PASSED rather than that its header exists.

tasks.title: Emit GROUPS-PASSED
tasks.description: In tests/run-tests.sh add per-group pass tracking (a grp helper sets the current group; ko records a failure for it) and print GROUPS-PASSED: <ids of groups with zero failures> before the RESULT line.

tasks.title: Rewrite our gate criteria
tasks.description: Rewrite the coverage-gate criteria in planning/*.dag.json from a bare-header grep (run-tests.sh | grep Tnn) to the outcome form (green AND GROUPS-PASSED:.* Tnn), and replace source-string grep gates (grep 'def X' file) with behavioral checks (import + assert callable/shape). Keep every DAG lint- and audit-clean.

tasks.title: Skill guidance
tasks.description: Update the /heartbeat plan rules in plugin/skills/heartbeat/SKILL.md: coverage gates must assert the OUTCOME (a group PASSED via GROUPS-PASSED / a specific test run), not that a name exists; prefer behavioral checks over grepping a source string.

tasks.title: Clean the template
tasks.description: Fix plugin/templates/dag.json so hb-audit reports 0 warnings (resolve the GATE_P1 gate_offphase: have a P1 task produce output/result.json, or re-point the gate), keeping the T2 assertions green (GATE_P0 passes on a fresh bootstrap).

tasks.title: Docs + version
tasks.description: Add a STATUS.md note; bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json + marketplace.json to 1.16.0 and py/pyproject.toml to 0.8.0 (update the version-bump test); rebuild and extract-test the package.

review.prompt: Refute that GS0 is done: does GROUPS-PASSED actually list only groups with ZERO failing checks (so a red group is excluded), or does it list every group regardless? Would a coverage gate keyed on GROUPS-PASSED fail if that group's checks fail? Is T52 hollow (asserting the header, not the outcome)?
